DDL	CREATE TABLE t (a STRING, b INT, c STRING, d STRING) USING parquet
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW temp_v AS SELECT * FROM t
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW temp_Data_Source_View
DDL	CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT * FROM t
DDL	ALTER TABLE t SET TBLPROPERTIES (e = '3')
DDL	ALTER TABLE t ADD PARTITION (c='Us', d=1)
READ	DESCRIBE t
READ	DESCRIBE EXTENDED t AS JSON
PARSE_ERROR	DESCRIBE t AS JSON
PARSE_ERROR	DESC FORMATTED t a AS JSON
READ	DESC default.t
READ	DESC TABLE t
READ	DESC FORMATTED t
READ	DESC EXTENDED t
DDL	ALTER TABLE t UNSET TBLPROPERTIES (e)
READ	DESC EXTENDED t
DDL	ALTER TABLE t UNSET TBLPROPERTIES (comment)
READ	DESC EXTENDED t
READ	DESC t PARTITION (c='Us', d=1)
READ	DESC EXTENDED t PARTITION (c='Us', d=1) AS JSON
READ	DESC EXTENDED t PARTITION (c='Us', d=1)
READ	DESC FORMATTED t PARTITION (c='Us', d=1)
READ	DESC EXTENDED t PARTITION (C='Us', D=1)
READ	DESC t PARTITION (c='Us', d=2)
READ	DESC t PARTITION (c='Us')
PARSE_ERROR	DESC t PARTITION (c='Us', d)
DDL	DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS test_schema
DDL	CREATE SCHEMA test_schema DEFAULT COLLATION UNICODE
READ	DESCRIBE SCHEMA EXTENDED test_schema
PARSE_ERROR	ALTER SCHEMA test_schema DEFAULT COLLATION UTF8_LCASE
READ	DESCRIBE SCHEMA EXTENDED test_schema
READ	DESC temp_v
READ	DESC TABLE temp_v
READ	DESC FORMATTED temp_v
READ	DESC EXTENDED temp_v
READ	DESC temp_Data_Source_View
READ	DESC temp_v PARTITION (c='Us', d=1)
READ	DESC v
READ	DESC TABLE v
READ	DESC FORMATTED v
READ	DESC EXTENDED v
READ	DESC v PARTITION (c='Us', d=1)
READ	EXPLAIN DESC t
READ	EXPLAIN DESC EXTENDED t
READ	EXPLAIN EXTENDED DESC t
READ	EXPLAIN DESCRIBE t b
READ	EXPLAIN DESCRIBE t PARTITION (c='Us', d=2)
READ	EXPLAIN DESCRIBE EXTENDED t PARTITION (c='Us', d=2) AS JSON
DDL	CREATE TABLE d (a STRING DEFAULT 'default-value', b INT DEFAULT 42) USING parquet COMMENT 'table_comment'
READ	DESC d
READ	DESC EXTENDED d
READ	DESC TABLE EXTENDED d
READ	DESC FORMATTED d
DDL	CREATE TABLE e (a STRING DEFAULT CONCAT('a\n b\n ', 'c\n d'), b INT DEFAULT 42) USING parquet COMMENT 'table_comment'
READ	DESC e
READ	DESC EXTENDED e
READ	DESC TABLE EXTENDED e
READ	DESC FORMATTED e
DDL	CREATE TABLE f USING json PARTITIONED BY (B, C) AS SELECT 'APACHE' A, CAST('SPARK' AS BINARY) B, TIMESTAMP'2018-11-17 13
READ	DESC FORMATTED f PARTITION (B='SPARK', C=TIMESTAMP'2018-11-17 13:33:33')
READ	DESC TABLE EXTENDED f PARTITION (B='SPARK', C=TIMESTAMP'2018-11-17 13:33:33') AS JSON
SESSION	DROP VIEW temp_v
SESSION	DROP VIEW temp_Data_Source_View
SESSION	DROP VIEW v
DDL	DROP TABLE t
DDL	DROP TABLE d
DDL	DROP TABLE e
DDL	DROP TABLE f
